description: This file is the entry point for a React application using ReactDOM to render the root component into the DOM. It imports necessary modules including React, ReactDOM, global CSS, and the main App component, then initializes the rendering process.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering a React component tree into a specific DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the created root.
